project_akantilado_short_desc: Solo sound designer on a student 3D animation about two cats chasing a golden orb. Built 5-layer jungle ambience, synced foley to animation frames, mixed for both stereo and 5.1 surround.
project_amorak_short_desc: Sound design for a horror animation. I built the creature roar from scratch using 4 animal layers and mixed the entire soundscape in binaural 3D audio.
project_audioq_short_desc: VST3/AU sampler plugin built in JUCE. Granular synthesis, hand-coded tremolo DSP, TPT filters, and a built-in compressor. Open source on GitHub.
project_gradwork_short_desc: Bachelor thesis: tested 3 AI audio models for real-time game use. None were fast enough, so I built a predictive caching system that serves pre-generated sounds in under 55ms.
project_middleware-optimization_short_de: Three Wwise school projects: voice limits in a zombie shooter, spatial audio in a platformer, and fitting audio into 15MB on Android.
project_not_today_darling_short_desc: Solo audio designer on a 6-person student team. Made all the sounds—from bouncy disco music to ridiculous item pickups. We even voiced the grandmas ourselves. Fixed the 4-player audio chaos so UI feedback doesn't disappear when everyone crashes at once.
project_pause_and_deserve_short_desc: Horror game where pausing the game freezes time, but the enemy gets faster when you unpause. Audio reacts to how long you hesitate.
project_pawism_short_desc: 48-hour game jam. Solo audio: UI clicks, ambient tension loops, and Wwise implementation under pressure. Good exercise in fast iteration and prioritizing what matters.
project_ray_animation_short_desc: Disco-funk score for a graduation film. Original composer dropped out with 8 days left. I wrote and delivered the track in time for the cinema screening.
project_richter_short_desc: Complete sound design for a student earthquake film. Recorded all foley and ambiences with a Zoom H6, wrote a short orchestral score. No commercial libraries -- everything from scratch.
project_shadow_frames_short_desc: Audio designer on a multi-school horror game (Wwise + UE5.5 + C++). Sound is the only way to find anomalies. I built the footstep system, enemy proximity audio, and 3-stage anomaly detection.
project_sound-design_short_desc: God of War combat redesign, Baldur's Gate spell FX remake, realistic vs. sci-fi weapon synthesis, and a sci-fi linear redesign. All original recordings and processing.
project_transientica_audiolab_short_desc: Control a rhythm game using only your voice. Real-time beatbox recognition with <60ms latency.
project_unreal_engine_rebuilder_short_de: Automation script: cleans Intermediate/Saved folders and regenerates project files. Resolves linker errors and saves manual cleanup time.
project_wwise_unreal_fixer_short_desc: Python script that fixes broken Wwise references in Unreal. Solves the common "missing audio" issue after Perforce pulls with one click.
